CustomField.description: QualifiedApiName of an alternate Form Component used for a Table section's single-row New/Edit modal, distinct from the form that supplies the table's columns. Passed as override-table-form-name to c-flow-data-table. Leave blank to edit rows with the table's own source form.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional Form to use for the single-row add/edit popup on a Table section, when you want a different layout than the table's columns. Leave blank to reuse the table's source form.
CustomField.label: Alternate_FormQualifiedApiName
